dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Oh, hello hello!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: This place is seriously cool! So you and Paimon have this whole space to yourselves? It must feel a little empty sometimes — maybe I should come and hang out more often? Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I like this place a lot! It's really nice.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: The scenery is wonderful, and I love what you've done with the interior — very tasteful. You never fail to impress.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks. Not quite as nice as your place, though.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Oh, don't be silly. It's not a competition.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Every home's character is unique to its owner. It's not a question of good or bad, just... personality.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Yeah, that sums it up nicely — your home is a reflection of your personality!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Just one look around here, and I can tell that this place belongs to you and Paimon.

choices.text: What kind of style do you like in a home?

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Hmm... cozy and practical, I guess? Beyond that, I'm really not that picky.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Melus actually did most of the interior decor at my place. I've always been quite fond of his style, and now that I've gotten used to it, I'm reluctant to change things up.

choices.text: Well, if you like it here, you're welcome to visit whenever you want!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Really? Literally, whenever I want? Because I'll definitely be taking you up on that offer.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Don't worry, I'll make sure to always come with snacks. Home-made cookies, little cakes... and whatever else you like.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Oh, and I'm happy to bring enough for Paimon, too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Sure thing! I mean, that's the whole point of coming here to hang out.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Hmm... So, what's new with you? Anything in particular on your mind lately?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hats. Can we talk hats for a second?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Ah yes. We certainly can. You know, you should consider getting yourself a hat.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: And I don't mean a hat to keep your ears warm or your head dry... I just think your hairstyle would look really neat with a hat!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well then, maybe we should go clothes-shopping together sometime.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Oh, sure! I'll take you to the best shop in all of Fontaine. Let me think... Yeah, you and Paimon could both do with fancy outfits for formal occasions, as well as a hat and a new pair of leather shoes...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Actually, come to think of it — how have you dressed for formal occasions in the past?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We pretty much just wear the same thing all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Really? Huh, that's a surprise... That's cool though. I like how you don't get hung up about that kind of thing.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I often find that people who don't stress about their appearance are the most chilled-out.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Whatever the world throws at them, they just take it as it comes — no nonsense, no pretensions. Honestly, I think that's pretty awesome.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I guess traveling the world instills that kind of confidence in you, huh? ...But still, let's definitely get you a nice hat and some leather shoes when we have the chance!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Let's do something together! We could go on a hike, climb some trees, pet some cats, walk some puppies... I'm honestly down with whatever.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure you can climb trees in that dress?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: You'd better believe it! There might be quite a bit of skirt in the back, but it's not restricting.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I made sure of that before I bought it. I specifically asked the designer to make some alterations, so I could maintain freedom of movement.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you ever had any pets?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I had a dog once, many, many years ago, but after she passed away from an illness, I never got another.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: My papa named her "Shelly." There wasn't any special meaning to the name — we just happened to find her right after coming back from a trip to the seaside.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I loved that dog. We'd go out together all the time, and she'd take me on adventures through the abandoned pipes... She was really smart that way.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You must miss her a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Definitely. Sometimes, I have dreams where we're playing together again, but I usually get over it pretty quickly once I wake up.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I'm sure Shelly wouldn't want me to live in the past. She'd want me to move forward with my life and make more good friends.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Come on, that should go without saying! After all the life-and-death situations we've been through together? That definitely makes you one of my greatest friends of all time!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: I doubt I'll make many more friends like you in my lifetime, so I'll cherish our friendship to the end.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Anyway, as your great friend, how about I bake a cake that has all of our names on it — you, me, and Paimon — and bring it here for us all to share?

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Something tells me that Paimon would really enjoy that... So I'm willing to spoil her just this once!

choices.text: Can I call you one of my good friends?

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Hahaha, please, we crossed that bridge a long time ago!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Why would I ask to hang out with you here if we weren't already great friends?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Navia.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Good morning! I'm sure today will be a really great day.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Wanna go out for a quick walk? I don't mind where. Just bring a small bag, and let's head out right away!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Navia.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: *yawn* Yeah, I'm getting really sleepy — I think I'm gonna turn in. G'night, don't stay up too late.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Mmm... I really hope my dreams are sweet tonight.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Oh wow! I always thought that these metal sheet houses were difficult to build anywhere else.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: You never fail to impress.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: This has put me in the mood to go fishing. Wanna join?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Hmm... Have you ever noticed how all of Fontaine's restaurants seem to go for the same style of decor?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: You can't judge a restaurant by how fancy the furniture is. It all comes down to the quality of the food.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: #But since this is chez {NICKNAME}, I have no doubt that both the menu and the cooking are exceptional!
